verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration-only law firm whose core service is handling immigration applications. It states it provides "end-to-end immigration support, guiding clients through every step" and "processing visas," including for start-ups and founders. However, its docs never describe the components of petition preparation that the story names. missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence-binder assembly, drafting of expert and support letters, form preparation and filing handled by the firm, and any independent or client corroboration of end-to-end petition execution.
